name: Archivist AI MCP
description:
Archivist is an AI-powered campaign management platform for tabletop RPGs. It turns your recorded sessions into structured, searchable campaign memory — session recaps and shareable handouts, a compendium of NPCs, locations, factions and items, a play-by-play timeline, character arcs, and a canonical quest log — all shared with your whole party.

This connector gives Claude direct access to that campaign data, so you can work with your world in conversation instead of switching between tools.

With it enabled, you can:
- Browse and search campaigns, sessions, transcripts, and session handouts
- Look up characters, factions, locations, and items from your compendium
- Review story beats, moments, character arcs, and the campaign timeline
- Read and manage quests, journals, and journal folders
- Create, update, and delete campaign entities, and manage wiki-style links between them
- Upload images for characters, locations, and items

The server exposes 66 tools (28 read-only, 38 write operations) over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Access is scoped — profile, worlds_read, sessions_read, characters_read, and agent_write for mutating tools — and every write is checked against your campaign-level permissions, so Claude can only reach campaigns you already have access to.

Requires an Archivist account. Full MCP documentation, including the complete tool list and scope reference, is at https://developers.myarchivist.ai/mcp

_published_faq.name: How do I add Archivist AI MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Archivist AI MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.myarchivist.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Archivist AI MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Archivist AI MCP lists 67 MCP tools, including ask-campaign-tool, bulk-link-maintenance-tool, complete-image-upload-tool, create-beat-tool, create-campaign-tool, create-character-tool, create-faction-tool, create-item-tool, create-journal-folder-tool, create-journal-tool, create-link-tool, and create-location-tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Archivist AI MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Archivist AI MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Archivist AI MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Archivist AI MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Archivist AI MCP is developed by Archivist AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
